name: Hyrol Preen Beta
description: Hyrol Preen Beta was a planet in the Outer Rim. Its populace was wiped out by Imperial Storm commandos and ZQ infantry droids because of suspected Rebel activity. A spacer, Johin, brought news of the devastation.
